theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_ip_pt_cylinder_countablyRectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ N : Set (Eucl P), (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) N = 0 → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ N} = 0) → ∀ M : Set (Eucl P), CountablyRectifiable m M → CountablyRectifiable (m + 1) {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ M}
